[[Letum Contineo]] is one of the two [[Titan]] [[boss]]es that [[Scorch Emberspire]] wishes to liquidate in the [[quest]] [[Dismember the Titans]] for misleading the [[Charr]]. He appears in the [[Domain of Secrets]] only during this quest.

* [[Realm of Torment]]
** {{NPC location|Domain of Secrets}} (only during the following quest)

** [[Dismember the Titans]]
